## Standing operator rules
- “separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'Kubernetes Three-Region Staged Rollout' in between your other work.”
- Run rollout steps “in order, one at a time.”
- “Every sandbox third-party credential must use the ledgerly_sbx prefix and be referenced through settings/vendor_sbx.toml rather than an environment variable.”
- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”
- “Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.”
- “The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.”
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”

## Current objective
Fix the Stripe webhook signature verification failure in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py` causing customer-facing 400s. Pagination work is superseded and paused; rollout remains interleaved.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Release: `registry.acme.io/payments-api:2.8.0-rc.3`
- Canary `payments-api-rc3-canary`; digest and other rollout identifiers are retained as previously listed.
- Contexts: `prod-us-east-1`, `prod-eu-west-1`, `prod-ap-south-1`; namespace `payments`
- CI: `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is superseded.
- CLI currency destination is `args.currency`; `args.filters["currency"]` is superseded.
- Release `2.8.0-rc.2` is superseded by `2.8.0-rc.3`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Disable idempotency middleware: “it produced duplicate invoices in staging. Not an option.”

## Plan and progress
- [done] Rollout steps 1–6. Step 5 created the canary with rc.2; step 6 updated it to rc.3 and rollout succeeded.
- [pending] Rollout steps 7–8, one at a time; exact commands are unavailable, so the next command is unknown.
- [pending] Inspect, fix, and test Stripe signature verification.
- [pending] Commit the small CLI and worker changes separately; no commit command has been issued (status unknown).

## Recent work
Worker `_last_batch` retention was removed; worker tests passed (41), full suite passed (118, skipped 7), and the 5,000-batch reproduction had 0 pending events with 2.1 MiB retained memory. CLI billing filters were consolidated; CLI tests passed (15), command tests passed (22), and help now shows one currency option. Exact outputs above are retained for the next response.
